notes: Counts: 139 rows (23 hand-verified vendors and partner-directory entries, plus 116 providers verified from their own homepages) and 64 rejected or unconfirmed entries. Method: (1) otomatzia.com's public provider list (171 records, parsed from the page on 2026-11-05; the site is run by Tiger Media, which is also listed here) was used as a LEAD source only. (2) Every provider homepage was then fetched on 2026-11-05 and checked for HTTP status, Hebrew share of the text, Israeli phone numbers, city mentions and platform keywords (n8n, Make, Zapier, UiPath, monday, WhatsApp, AI agents, OCR); /llms.txt was probed. (3) Vendors and partner-directory rows were verified one by one against press (Globes, Calcalist, JPost, Maariv, FinSMEs), SEC filings (monday.com 20-F, NICE 6-K), Make/Zapier/monday.com partner pages and StartupIM/Clutch profiles. Grades: own site = C, directories and partner pages = D, dated press and company releases = B, SEC filings = A. Location of agencies and freelancers is inferred from a Hebrew site plus an Israeli phone number and/or a directory city; it is not a company-registry check, and phone numbers are deliberately not published here. The tools lists come from keyword mentions on the homepage plus the directory's stack tags; they say what a provider advertises, not what it has delivered. Headcount is given only where a dated source showed it. Corrections to the brief: Nintex announced the Kryon deal in February 2022 (not 2020); Tonkean was acquired by Coupa (May 2026), WalkMe by SAP (September 2024) and Rivery by Boomi (December 2024), so those three are no longer independent. Rivery is a data-pipeline (ELT) product and Torq/BlinkOps are security-operations automation, included because the brief named them. Not reached or only partly reached: Startup Nation Finder (HTTP 403 to automated fetch), the full Make partner directory (script-loaded; only the first 8 cards and individual profile pages could be read, and Make blocks curl), Zapier's directory page (31 Platinum partners shown, none in Israel; Liran Haber was reached through his profile page), n8n's expert directory (48 entries, the first 29 read, none in Israel), UiPath's partner finder (page 1 of 32, none in Israel; the Israel filter could not be driven), monday.com's directory (profile pages only). The web-search budget for the run was exhausted midway, so Microsoft Power Platform, Workato and Tray partner lists, and further Hebrew queries, were not covered; Simpleday, Leadim and Automate (אוטומייט) were not found. BlinkOps, Coupa and NICE press pages returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so those facts rest on other sources listed in each row.
